description: This file defines an internal struct CapacityPartition used for partitioning cache capacity into hot, warm, and cold segments, favoring frequently accessed items with a warm queue, and includes logic for initialization and capacity computation.

classes.name: CapacityPartition
classes.description: An internal struct that manages cache capacity allocations across hot, warm, and cold categories with customizable ratios.

methods.name: CapacityPartition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes capacity partitioning with default warm ratio.

methods.name: CapacityPartition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes capacity partitioning with specified warm ratio.

methods.name: ComputeQueueCapacity
methods.description: Static method that calculates hot, warm, and cold capacities based on total capacity and warm ratio.
